claim_class: two live T2 runs of one real system (Hermes native) and one live run of the no-memory floor, on the public T2 pack, beside the pack's scripted naive-retrieval and oracle-evidence controls; an exploratory reading by kind of task on the twin-pair scale. Five public lives carry scored actions. A developer-tier result: no bar, no certification, not predictive of the full tier, and no significance is claimed.
does_not_prove: Public lives, not fresh ones; five lives with scored actions; one reader model at one effort.
One real system. The two scripted rows are not live retrieval results.
A scripted life: no system's own judgment about what to store is tested.
The live floor ran once; run 2 reused it.
Kinds of task are the pack's own templates and twin types, read after the runs: this is exploratory.
title: Milestone 1, step 1: the 4 November live runs, read by kind of task (#495)
